prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit / animation sprite sheet. The attached image is a flawed six-frame trash-bin animation. Correct the LID perspective and output ONLY THE SIX SEPARATE LIDS, no bucket bodies. One transparent sprite sheet with exact 3 columns x 2 rows equal cells. Treat this as ONE rigid rounded rectangular sage-green lid rotating about a FIXED rear horizontal hinge under a fixed front slightly elevated game camera. Same thin metal thickness, same painted texture and frame dimensions in all six cells. No changing lid size or design. TWO small hinge blocks fixed identically in each cell at x35% and65%, y60% of its cell. Lid rear-edge width approximately 60% of cell; total maximum width must NEVER exceed 68% of cell, open lid slightly narrower than closed because its front edge recedes from viewer. Six poses row-major: 0 degrees CLOSED (lid extends BELOW hinge toward camera, y60..85%), 15 degrees SLIGHT open (front edge y76%), 30 degrees SMALL open (nearly edge-on, front lip y64%), 50 degrees HALF open (underside now visible ABOVE hinge, leading edge y44%), 70 degrees WIDE open (leading edge y27%), 90 degrees FULL open (leading edge y17%). Rear hinge fixed at y60% in EVERY cell. Each frame ONLY ONE thin lid, no extra panel beneath it, no hanging flap, no duplicated rim. Dark sage underside on the final three, warm green top on first three. Keep the reference warm hand-painted cream rim highlights and two hinge blocks. True alpha transparency all outside lids. NO bucket, no shadows, no background, no labels, no grid lines. Important: lid physical width stays constant and the geometry is coherent across all six, no wider lid when open. Landscape 1536x1024 sheet.

Edit this six lid animation into a SQUARE transparent PNG sticker sheet. Arrange the EXACT same six lid poses as TWO columns THREE rows, equal cells. Remove the entire background and glows, replace with real alpha transparency. Each cell only a single lid. Row1: closed, slightly open. Row2: nearly edge on, half open. Row3: mostly open, fully open. Preserve these coherent thin lids and consistent width, sage green hand-painted design and two hinge blocks. Do not add a bin body or anything else. Keep isolated lid silhouettes with plenty of empty transparent padding around each cell. Square canvas 1024x1024, NOT landscape. Background must be empty transparent, not brown, not black, not checkerboard. Each lid remains a separate object.
preparation: Split generated 2x3 intermediate sheet into six standalone frames; normalize lid projected widths and hinge alignment; keep v1 bucket body; export transparent 1280x1280 canvases. No game or Spine edits.
